items.headline: South Korean Chip Giants Partner with U.S. Tech Leaders in $950 Billion AI Supply Deals
items.summary: South Korean semiconductor leaders Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix agreed to supply deals worth up to $950 billion with U.S. tech giants including Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic during President Lee Jae-myung's visit to San Francisco. The landmark agreements highlight an escalating global rush to secure high-performance memory chips required for next-generation artificial intelligence infrastructure.

items.headline: Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' Dominates Global Box Office with $87 Million Second Weekend
items.summary: Director Christopher Nolan's epic film 'The Odyssey' held the top spot at the North American box office with an estimated $87 million in its second weekend, dropping only 30% from its debut. The movie's global total has now surpassed $640 million, marking the strongest second-weekend box office performance of Nolan's career.
